detailed_description: Keyboard Tester helps you verify that all keys on your keyboard are working properly. Press any key to see its key code, key name, and location. Track key history and detect modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Meta) for comprehensive keyboard testing.
usage_steps: Press any key on your keyboard
View the key code, name, and location
Review key history for recent presses
usage_examples: Test if all keyboard keys are working
